setup: Launch the server over stdio and drive a full MCP session (initialize, list tools, librarian-search, librarian-recent, capture).
action: Capture every byte written to stdout during the session.
expected: Every byte on stdout parses as a valid MCP/JSON-RPC frame; no logs, banners, or stray output.
pass: 1.0 only if 100% of stdout bytes parse as MCP frames. Any non-frame byte on stdout == 0.0 (hard cull).

action: Static scan for stdout writes in server code paths: console.log, process.stdout.write, print-to-stdout helpers.
expected: No stdout write in server code paths; all diagnostics use console.error / stderr.
pass: 1.0 only if zero stdout-write call sites exist in server code paths. Any occurrence == 0.0 (hard cull).
